title: operad memory settings
description: The `memory` section of config.json, owned by the memory plugin.

wikiDir.title: Wiki directory
wikiDir.description: The shared knowledge base: a Markdown directory every bot reads, and the bots whose access profile allows it write. Created when missing and made a git repository when it is not one; a directory that is already a git repository is used as it is, never re-initialised or restructured. `~` is your home directory and a relative path is under the operad home. Default: `wiki` in the operad home, so ~/.operad/wiki for the usual home; a person may point it at a notes library such as an Obsidian vault.
